searchText: TBH, I don't think https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/404 is a substantial change that should block the devnet from being launched. If its not a substantial change, then can't it just be merged too? I'm not saying that its gonna slow down the launch of devnet 6 by any means, just want to have a nice checklist, with all the open PRs being merged. It is a pretty long discussion in there, i would expect it to be merged pretty soon but who knows 😄 <@827653956955406406> <@680245613258211336> <dankrad> 7020 and 7095 are merged Yes, saw it thanks are there any plans to have releases, similar to consensus specs for execution EIPs ? Would be nice to specify specific release instead of just a hash of a commit. 404 is merged as well only #398 is left now.
